properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities: cap:kpp-proposal is a skill, captured minutes ago when Anthony asked how a user actually says something is a KPP, and nothing is written for it yet. Worth naming what it is NOT, because the temptation will be real once someone starts: it must not become a rule that auto-promotes requirements whose statements contain "must" or a number. Criticality is a claim about consequence — what happens to the effort if the threshold is missed — and that is not recoverable from wording. The signals justify ASKING; they never justify setting.
